extractor: page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor), full pages joined by one newline; check exact font alignment
selection: Every physical page, title, abstract, body, acknowledgements, bibliography. Remove only occurrence-bound page numbers and repeated running furniture. No body-only selection.
calibration: Visible glyph identity only, determined independently for these PDFs from rendered pages and embedded fonts; exact codepoint/font/page/offset/context and PDF-event location for whitespace aliases. No linguistic/mathematical correction, dehyphenation, coalescing, reordering or deletion. Preserve raw sensitivities.

unit_definitions.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

primary_program_boundary: All eight complete mathematical programs (five required and three diagnostics), printed once in the full 12-page appendix. All eight full raw files are an alternative representation, never added to the appendix. Two full drivers inventoried separately. No pruning.

comparison_policy.written: sum of all three whole source manuscript costs / (whole U_D + D1 + D2 + D3)
comparison_policy.including_program: same numerator / (whole U_D + D1 + D2 + D3 + whole CODE)
comparison_policy.conditional: source_i / D_i after acquiring the whole U_D and whole declared complete programme boundary, including all five required programs; diagnostic parts are not silently dropped

formal_validation: Separate cost/scope, not automatic full-source formalization. No later support-count supplement included.
excluded_source_clauses: Keep exact accepted scope.json qualifications; L104 printed diagrams/Aut/Cor/doubling not all recovered; M22 excluded.
export_boundary: Scripts, metadata, counts, exact furniture and glyph hashes only. No primary PDF, text, or raster redistribution.
